documentation.file_docstring:
Data models for the self-correcting agent kernel.

Note: Core failure primitives (FailureType, FailureSeverity, AgentFailure, FailureTrace)
are imported from agent-primitives (Layer 1) and re-exported here for backward compatibility.
inline_comments: Import from agent-primitives (Layer 1) and re-export for backward compatibility
Note: FailureTrace and AgentFailure are now imported from agent-primitives above
member_docstrings: CognitiveGlitch: Types of cognitive glitches that can occur in agent reasoning.
FailureAnalysis: Analysis of an agent failure.
DiagnosisJSON: Structured diagnosis identifying cognitive glitches in agent reasoning.
SimulationResult: Result of simulating an alternative path.
ShadowAgentResult: Result of running a shadow agent with counterfactual simulation.
CorrectionPatch: A patch to correct an agent's behavior.
AgentState: Current state of an agent.
GiveUpSignal: Types of give-up signals indicating agent laziness.
PatchDecayType: Classification of patch based on decay characteristics.
